content: The physical examination should include a comprehensive inspection of the feet to evaluate skin integrity, identify any lesions, and detect deformities. Peripheral arterial disease (PAD) screening should be performed by palpating the pedal pulses, and patients should be referred for further evaluation if the ankle-brachial index (ABI) is found to be decreased. Sensory and reflex assessments should be conducted using a 10-gram monofilament test and temperature testing to evaluate for potential neuropathy.
